entities.name: Lorris
entities.description: A soldier of Inys Nohr and daughter of commander RoNal, who turned on Felonarch Nazir.

entities.name: RoNal
entities.description: Commander of Inys Nohr and Lorris's father, who sacrificed himself.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Felonarch of Inys Nohr who disgraced RoNal.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Keeper Logan's daughter, imprisoned and later healer of Nazir.

entities.name: Keeper Logan
entities.description: Killed in the raid on Inys Haen.

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: Young slave who stole a boat with Lorris.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Fled with Nazir toward Inys Haen.

entities.name: The Frog
entities.description: Monstrous creature in the dungeon to which RoNal sacrificed himself.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: Site where the Awakening Ritual was recited.

events.summary: Lorris takes part in the raid on Inys Haen in which Keeper Logan is killed and Aylith imprisoned.
events.quote: including in the raid that saw Keeper Logan killed and his daughter Aylith imprisoned

events.summary: Lorris witnesses RoNal's disgrace by Nazir and finds him in a dungeon.
events.quote: Lorris witnessed her father RoNal ’s disgrace at the hands of the Felonarch Nazir.

events.summary: Lorris strikes a deal with Jedhian to rescue RoNal.
events.quote: she struck a deal with Jedhian

events.summary: RoNal sacrifices himself to The Frog so Jedhian survives.
events.quote: RoNal sacrificed himself to The Frog

events.summary: Lorris aids Aylith and Jedhian's escape and steals a boat with Arn to pursue Nazir.
events.quote: She aided Aylith and Jedhian in their escape

events.summary: Lorris corners Nazir at Inys Haen but Jedhian persuades her to take him prisoner; Nazir escapes.
events.quote: Jedhian intervened, convincing her to take him prisoner instead.

events.summary: Aylith heals Nazir of his madness and the Clan Tree is mended.
events.quote: witnessing the return of sunlight and warmth to the land

relations.quote: eventually turned on him for his crimes, swearing revenge
she would aid in his and Aylith’s escape
Lorris was a soldier of Inys Nohr
